observations: One small, low resolution side view of an adult bicycle standing on a concrete yard, with tyres stacked behind it.
Black frame with red lettering on the down tube; the lettering is too small and blurred to read, so no brand can be named.
Thin road style tyres on large wheels, a flat handlebar with red grips held by a hand at the right edge.
Front chainrings and a rear derailleur are visible, so it is a geared bike; the number of cogs cannot be counted.
Shifters and brake levers on the handlebar are too small to make out.
A watermark crosses the middle of the photo.
No close photos of the frame, drivetrain, brakes or tyres, and no clip of it being ridden or shifted.

identity.kind: adult geared road bicycle with flat handlebar

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows front chainrings and a rear derailleur, but the chainrings and cogs cannot be counted at this resolution.
Something is mounted on the handlebar in photo 0 but the shifters are too small to see.
Frame material cannot be told from a painted frame in one small photo; no frame sticker or close up shown.
Riding speed cannot be judged from a photo.

risks.risk: Frame may be steel rather than aluminium, or cracked or bent.
risks.proof: Close photos of the frame tubes and welds, plus any frame sticker naming the material.
risks.if_unproven: as a basic steel frame bicycle

risks.risk: Gears may not shift through all speeds; worn chain or bent derailleur.
risks.proof: Clip of the bike on a stand with the pedals turned while shifting through every gear front and rear.
Clip of each brake lever pulled with the wheel spinning and stopping.
Clip of each wheel spun in the frame, viewed from the front, and close photos of the tyre tread.
risks.if_unproven: as needing wheel truing and new tyres

risks.risk: Photo may not be of the seller's own bike.
risks.proof: Photo of the bike with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name on the saddle.
risks.if_unproven: priced only on the agent's inspection before payment

proof_requests: Clip shifting through every gear while turning the pedals.
Close photos of the down tube lettering and any frame sticker showing brand and material.
Close photo of the handlebar shifters and brake levers.
Clip of both brakes stopping a spinning wheel and each wheel spun for wobble.
Photo of the bike with a handwritten note of today's date.
response.reason: It is clearly an adult geared road bicycle and can be priced by type at its worst case, as a basic steel frame bike needing a service, until the gear count, frame material and brand are proven.
